### CVE-2015-4852
- Assigner: oracle | Published: 2015-11-18 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: n/a; CWE-502 CWE-502 Deserialization of Untrusted Data
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Unknown — Oracle WebLogic Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 42806: Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3.6.0 - Java Deserialization Remote Code Execution (remote/java, 2017-09-27, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 46628: Oracle Weblogic Server Deserialization RCE - Raw Object (Metasploit) (remote/multiple, 2019-03-28, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 44552: Websphere/JBoss/OpenNMS/Symantec Endpoint Protection Manager - Java Deserialization Remote Code Execution (remote/multiple, 2016-07-20, verified=0)

The WLS Security component in Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3.6.0, 12.1.2.0, 12.1.3.0, and 12.2.1.0 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands via a crafted serialized Java object in T3 protocol traffic to TCP port 7001, related to oracle_common/modules/com.bea.core.apache.commons.collections.jar. NOTE: the scope of this CVE is limited to the WebLogic Server product.
